# Scrub the Deck
> Specialist pitch deck agency with an 81% fundraising success rate. Founded by David Pugh.

Scrub the Deck is a London-based pitch deck agency that designs investor pitch decks for seed, Series A, and Series B startups. The agency is founded and led by David Pugh, a pitch deck consultant and investment strategist with 22 years of experience. Clients include BBC, Aston Martin, Cisco, and 100+ tech founders.

## Core expertise
- Pitch deck design and strategy
- Investor narrative and financial storytelling
- Fundraising preparation and investor targeting
- Brand positioning for fundraising rounds

## Services
- Full pitch deck creation (strategy, copy, design)
- Pitch deck audit and redesign
- Investor readiness coaching
- Ongoing fundraising support

## Key facts
- 81% fundraising success rate (as of June 2026)
- 200+ pitch decks created
- Network of active investors across seed, Series A, and growth stages
- Typical turnaround: 2–4 weeks

## Blog
The Scrub the Deck blog covers pitch deck strategy, investor psychology, financial storytelling, and fundraising best practices. All articles are written or reviewed by David Pugh. Articles are available at https://scrubthedeck.com/blog
